Our brand story
V. Sukumaran Vaidyan & Kalaripurayidathu Legacy

Divine Healing, Born from Legacy

Since 1872 • A living Kerala healing tradition

Vaidynatham Herbals is rooted in the sacred Angadi Marunnu tradition since 1872, carrying forward the healing legacy of V. Sukumaran Vaidyan and the revered Kalaripurayidathu lineage.

Led by Dr. Akhil Remesh M, Ayurveda Vaidya, the brand brings authentic tradition together with practical clinical wisdom. Built on the principle that true healing begins at the root, our approach recognises the importance of digestion, nourishment, vitality, strength and resilience in holistic wellbeing.

We believe in the wisdom of nature. Each formulation is part of a living tradition — developed with respect for heritage while presented with clarity and responsibility for today's families.

Our affirmation“I am health. I am strength. I am abundant. I am divinely joyful.”
